description: Player A in a Chrome browser instance and Player B in a Firefox browser instance, plus a separate Chrome host UI context, agree on the seeded one-PC or four-PC party.
A host UI user_input commit appears once and in strictly increasing sequence order in both player projections.
Player active-PC changes synchronize, and competing stale-revision selections converge without a lost revision.
Approved sheets, initiative/combat, and the projected busy/ready state match the same server snapshot.
Submitting an identical command twice with one request ID returns the original receipt and enqueues one transcript input.
A full one-item runtime queue returns a visible busy receipt and does not append the rejected input.
Refresh and offline/online reconnect hydrate canonical state without resubmitting draft input.

A player page remains open during a verified tmp/combat_capture host restart; pending input becomes uncertain, is not replayed or duplicated, and a fresh snapshot resynchronizes. BLOCKED without --manage-sandbox-host.

With only tmp/combat_capture/web/frontend/dist absent, host UI remains usable, the player listener fails closed, and the original bundle is restored with manifest digests verified. BLOCKED without --manage-sandbox-host.

With one sandbox dist asset digest corrupted, host UI remains usable, the player listener fails closed, and the original bundle is restored with manifest digests verified. BLOCKED without --manage-sandbox-host.
Host-only routes and events are refused on the player origin, with no privileged payload or host marker in loaded player JavaScript.
